additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425137-DC/Si-D/NZ- [MP / N5 160345946] Charging session stopped CRM:02832000018
additional_info.body:
Dear Liz Hatton,
I hope this message finds you well.
Following your recent charging session, we have completed our analysis of the system logs. Our investigation indicates that the session ended due to a normal shutdown — specifically, charging was stopped after a timeout during the stop charge phase.
This means the system initiated the session termination process, but the expected stop confirmation did not occur within the allowed timeframe, resulting in an automatic timeout and session closure.
Please let us know if you experienced any unusual behavior during the session or if you have any further questions or concerns
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425137-DC/Si-D/NZ- [MP / N5 160345946] Charging session stopped CRM:02832000018
additional_info.body:
Dear Liz Hatton,
Yes, to summarise, the charging session ended due to a timeout. This occurred because the system did not receive response from the bus within the expected timeframe, likely due to a lack of communication from the bus at that stage.
Please let me know if you need any further details.
